script:
Li Xinyue
More than ten years ago, Li Xinyue had a happy family. But fate didn't favor this poor woman - her husband joined a cult organization and never returned. When she saw in the newspaper that the cult had been raided by police and her husband's name was on the list of victims, she no longer held much hope for this world. She began believing in Buddhism, hoping to find inner peace.
She often went to Fengbo Temple outside the city to burn incense and worship Buddha. Master Yanren in the temple was an honest and kind person like her deceased husband. Li Xinyue often listened to Yanren teach about Zen to believers, which gave her broken heart some stability again. Later, when Fengbo Temple opened Quchenju for lay disciples to reside in, Li Xinyue, having no attachments, moved in without hesitation.
Through repeated contact with Yanren, she couldn't help but develop feelings beyond mere respect. She knew this was wrong - she was a Buddhist believer herself, and Yanren was a monk - so she could only bury these feelings deep in her heart.
Another woman living permanently at Quchenju who was about her age was named Zhang Qingzhu. She often chatted with Zhang Qingzhu, and they got along well. But unlike herself, Zhang Qingzhu was very fond of material possessions. Li Xinyue often advised her to let go of these things, but Zhang Qingzhu wouldn't listen.
On the evening of July 24th, Li Xinyue was walking in the back garden when she saw Yanren approaching with a worried expression. Li Xinyue went forward to inquire, and Yanren only said he was in a very bad mood. She used the Zen principles she had learned over the years to comfort Yanren. Yanren became interested as he listened, and they talked until late at night before returning to rest.
Just as Li Xinyue returned to her room, Abbot Yankong came to see her, saying that Yanren was very opposed to the temple's current income-generating methods, thinking they betrayed Buddhist teachings and greatly hindered the development of Buddhist enterprise. He hoped she could persuade Yanren. If Yanren really wouldn't agree, they would use extreme measures to force him to break his vows and expel him from Buddhism.
Li Xinyue naturally understood what this meant and hesitated, afraid of hurting Yanren. But Yankong told her that he understood his junior brother best - Yanren actually had feelings for Li Xinyue but couldn't express them due to his status. If given a way out, he would definitely be willing. Li Xinyue was overjoyed to hear this and finally agreed.
On July 26th, Abbot Yankong invited her, Zhang Qingzhu, and Zhao Zhengwei, an investor who had always supported Fengbo Temple's enterprise, to dine together and persuade Yanren. But after much persuasion proved fruitless, Yankong had to take the next step. Yankong first sent Zhang Qingzhu away, then pushed the drugged food to Yanren. After Yanren ate it, the drug quickly took effect, and he was carried into a side room, with Li Xinyue, blushing, also entering.
After their intimate encounter, Yanren regained consciousness and found himself having broken his vows, crying bitterly while holding his head. Li Xinyue took the opportunity to confess her love, but Yanren had no reaction at all. He put on his clothes and left, no matter how she called to him. Only then did Li Xinyue realize she might have been deceived by Yankong. She thought for a while in the room, then got dressed to find Yankong. Yankong was quite blunt, saying he had used her, and now that his purpose was achieved, she should consider herself unlucky.
The feeling of falling from heaven to hell made Li Xinyue furious. She cursed Yankong, but he acted like he didn't care. Fine, then let you die.
Li Xinyue returned to her room with red eyes. This time she would act for her own dignity. She bought rat poison, ground it into powder, wrapped it in a handkerchief, and carried it with her at all times, ready to find an opportunity to poison him.
On the evening of August 2nd, Li Xinyue came to Zhang Qingzhu's room and found Zhang Qingzhu preparing some pastries for Yankong. Although she didn't know why Zhang Qingzhu was giving these to Yankong, this was a perfect opportunity. Li Xinyue, while Zhang Qingzhu wasn't paying attention, sprinkled the poison on the pastries. The white rat poison was the same color as the sugar frosting on the pastries - no one could tell the difference.
[August 3rd Morning]
At 5 AM, Li Xinyue went to morning prayers as usual, but this morning she had other purposes. Going out, she met Zhang Qingzhu. She had never seen Zhang Qingzhu attend morning prayers before. The two walked toward the prayer hall together. Li Xinyue had her own thoughts, and while Zhang Qingzhu kept trying to chat with her along the way, Li Xinyue just nodded and smiled without much to say. When they reached the prayer hall, they found Yankong sitting upright on his meditation cushion. Li Xinyue was disappointed. But after Yankong picked up the wooden fish mallet and prayer beads and began chanting, he suddenly collapsed to the ground after a short while. Those who rushed to check said he had already stopped breathing.
acts_goal: Do not proactively reveal that Zhang Qingzhu brought pastries to Yankong that evening.
